text.value: You have arrived at the coordinates given to you by the dead crewman you attempted to save. There doesn't seem to be anything here - no planets, no vessels, and no clue as to what he meant by sending you here.

options.label: (Slug Crew) Ask your Slug crewmember to scan for life forms.

text.value: A Zoltan ship decloaks and demands your reason for being here!
